based_on: ACORD 90 (Personal Auto) core fields + high-net-worth/collector-vehicle supplement (patterned after carriers like Chubb Masterpiece, PURE, AIG Private Client)

changelog.summary: Added enrichment_computed (formalizes VIN decode, title history, violation history, household check, sanctions screen, producer verification - previously invented ad hoc per edge case) and state_specific_extensions (per-state supplemental fields, e.g. MI no-fault/PIP tiers). Added driver_id to additional_drivers so enrichment records can key back to a specific driver. See referral-matrices/luxury_auto_referral_matrix.json for the rules that consume these fields.

applicant.ssn_last4: string (last 4 only recommended for storage minimization)
applicant.credit_based_insurance_score_band: enum[excellent, good, fair, poor, not_available] (state regulations vary on use)

additional_drivers.driver_id: string (UUID) - assigned at intake so enrichment_computed.additional_driver_enrichment can key back to this specific driver
additional_drivers.name: string

enrichment_computed.note: Populated by the pipeline's data-enrichment step (MVR pull, VIN decode, title history check, household driver check, sanctions screen, producer verification) AFTER intake and BEFORE referral matrix evaluation. Not applicant-submitted - this is the pipeline checking the applicant's story against external data, the same role the Energy manual's clearance/sanctions/Crystal-licensing checks play before an underwriter ever sees the file. Every field here should be readable by referral-matrices/luxury_auto_referral_matrix.json - if a referral rule needs enrichment data that isn't represented here, add the field here first rather than inventing an ad hoc shape on a specific application (this section exists precisely because that happened once already - see schema changelog).

household_driver_check.relationship_guess: string or null - e.g. 'child, age ~19, 2 violations on record'

title_history_check_result.disclosed_by_applicant: boolean - did the applicant disclose this brand anywhere on the form? Drives VV-02 in the referral matrix.

producer_verification.toba_executed: boolean - terms-of-business agreement on file, mirrors the Energy manual's pre-TOBA referral trigger

state_specific_extensions.note: Optional supplemental fields required only by certain states, keyed by 2-letter state code. What belongs under a given state's key is driven by that state's active state_rating_table record (see state_specific_application_fields in schemas/state_rating_table_schema.json), not hardcoded in this schema - this section is a namespace, not a fixed field list. Only populate the key for the vehicle's garaging state if that state has declared required fields; omit entirely for states with no supplemental requirements.

example_MI._comment: Illustrative only - Michigan's no-fault/PIP structure needs fields no other state in the registry currently requires.

underwriting_flags_computed.note: Populated by the AI pipeline post-intake, not by the applicant. Reads enrichment_computed + referral-matrices/luxury_auto_referral_matrix.json + the applicable state_rating_table record to produce this.
underwriting_flags_computed.referral_rule_ids_triggered: array of strings - e.g. ['DH-01', 'VV-02'] - every referral matrix rule_id that fired, even if the ultimate action was AUTO_PROCEED_WITH_FLAG rather than a referral. This is the field the NY DFS / Colorado AI-governance decision log is built from.
